 Follow Ryan Gosling Reveals How a Random Encounter with Julia Roberts Helped Him Through a Difficult Movie Shoot
 The ‘Project Hail Mary’ star says a chance conversation with the ‘Pretty Woman’ actress helped him with his performance
 Lily Brown Tue, October 20, 2026 at 6:25 PM UTC 4 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Ryan Gosling; Julia Roberts
Credit: Dominik Bindl/FilmMagic; Steve Granitz/FilmMagic NEED TO KNOW
 Ryan Gosling said Julia Roberts invited him to visit the set of her film After the Hunt 
 The actor said he was struggling with acting alone opposite a rock-like alien in Project Hail Mary 
 Gosling created a mop companion called Moppy Ringwald which ultimately appeared in the film
 Ryan Gosling found an unlikely solution to one of his biggest challenges on Project Hail Mar y and has Julia Roberts to thank for it.
 The actor, 45, recently opened up about an unexpected encounter with the 58-year-old actress while filming the sci-fi adventure, which required him to spend much of the movie acting opposite a rock-like alien named Rocky .
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement "I had been acting for a long time on the film, and gone through a lot of incarnations of the character, and really felt like I had tried everything I could think of," Gosling recently told IndieWire during a guild screening for the film.
 Ryan Gosling as Ryland Grace in 'Project Hail Mary' 
 Credit: Jonathan Olley/Amazon MGM Studios 
 Based on Andy Weir's bestselling novel, Project Hail Mary stars Gosling as Ryland Grace, a science teacher who wakes up alone aboard a spaceship with no memory of how he got there. As he pieces together his mission, he discovers he must solve the mystery of a substance causing the sun to die out in order to save Earth — and forms an unexpected friendship along the way.
 "I had been in a placenta onesie. I looked like a space caveman. I acted like I was born. I acted like I didn't know how to talk. I was a toddler. I was a man," he said. "And by the end of it, we got to this very expensive set, which was all these LED screens we had been waiting for to be built. We invested a lot of money in that, and it was very visually beautiful and fancy and high-tech. But I was just so tired of acting alone."

 Advertisement Advertisement According to IndieWire , he later crossed paths with Roberts while struggling with his role.
 "I'd never met her, and she sat down and talked to me," he said. "She was talking about how much fun she was having on her set with Luca Guadagnino on After the Hunt . She said, 'You should come over,' and I needed human interaction. So I went down to the set, and they were shooting a party scene, and they were all drinking and having fun, and they seemed like they were having a great time."
 Julia Roberts in 'After the Hunt' 
 Credit: Amazon MGM Studios/Youtube 
 Directed by Guadagnino, 55, After the Hunt stars Roberts as a college professor whose life is thrown into turmoil when a star student ( Ayo Edebiri ) accuses one of her colleagues ( Andrew Garfield ) of wrongdoing, forcing her to confront complicated moral questions and a secret from her own past.
 After getting a taste of the camaraderie on Roberts' set, Gosling told IndieWire he returned to Project Hail Mary ready to make a change.
 Advertisement Advertisement "When I returned to the set, I said, 'I want a friend, I want someone to act with,'" he said. "They were like, 'OK, but what do we do?' And I said, 'I want to get a mop, and I want to make it into a person and talk to it.'"
 "And they stopped everything on our fancy, expensive day, and crawled around the sets looking for tape and glasses, and a dress," Gosling added to the outlet. "And they helped me build this mop lady for me to do scenes with, who we called Moppy Ringwald."
 The makeshift scene partner ultimately made it into the film, despite being a far cry from the elaborate sets surrounding Gosling.
 "What were supposed to be these great visual scenes with all these LEDs, it was just a mop and sunglasses, and they put it in the movie," he said.
 Ryan Gosling and Julia Roberts are seen at Gucci Ancora during Milan Fashion Week on Sept. 22, 2023 
 Credit: Daniele Venturelli/Getty 
 For Gosling, the experience was a reminder that sometimes the best solutions come from the most unexpected places, including a conversation with an Oscar-winning actress.
 Advertisement Advertisement "If you're having a problem and you can't solve it, talk to Julia Roberts," said Gosling. "That's the big lesson here. She'll solve it for you."
 Roberts previously praised Gosling's performance in Barbie while speaking with PEOPLE in 2024, calling the film "so unique and new."
 "I met Ryan recently, a few times, and when you bring such dimension to a performance, it's remarkable," she said at the time.
 Project Hail Mary and After the Hunt are available to stream on Prime Video.
